values: 战斗开始前指定秩序，战斗开始时强制全体角色必须遵守一段时间；主动释放时，使秩序再次生效一段时间。

Dunlingr sets the stage for the battle's order before a battle starts, ensuring everyone follows it for a period of time.
Active. Dunlingr enforces the order again for an additional period of time.

战斗开始前，顿里尔可以指定本场战斗中秩序钟的形态为“<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_1">禁咒”或“<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_2">抑生”之一。
“<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_1">禁咒”：无法使用终极技能。
“<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_2">抑生”：无法治疗其他角色。
使用终极技能时，顿里尔使秩序钟降临，宣告指定的秩序并使双方非首领角色无条件服从，持续6 + 0.25秒。
被动地，每次秩序钟降临时，会对所有敌人造成200% + 20% ATK伤害，且战斗开始时，秩序钟会立刻降临，持续12 + 0.5秒。
顿里尔被击败后，秩序的生效时长衰减至剩余时间的30%。

Dunlingr designates the Bell of Order as either <sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_1">Spellbind or <sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_2">Curelock before a battle starts, setting the stage for the battle's order.
<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_1">Spellbind: Unable to cast Ultimate.
<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_2">Curelock: Unable to restore HP for others.
Active. Dunlingr summons the Bell of Order, declaring an order that all non-boss units on both sides must obey unconditionally for 6 + 0.25s.
Passive. Dunlingr summons the Bell of Order when a battle starts and keeps it on the battlefield for 12 + 0.5s. The Bell of Order deals 200% + 20% ATK damage to all enemies each time it is summoned.
After Dunlingr is defeated, the order's effect duration is reduced to 30% of the remaining time.
对面前的敌人造成伤害，并根据指定的秩序附带额外的效果。
Dunlingr deals damage to enemies in front of him and applies additional effects based on the specified order he has set.
发射音波，对面前3格宽、3格长的区域的敌人造成4段40% + 5% ATK伤害，秩序钟形态为“<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_1">禁咒”时，额外降低敌人60点攻击速度，持续4秒；秩序钟形态为“<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_2">抑生”时，额外附带敌人已损失生命值3%的伤害，该伤害最高不超过自身30%攻击力。

Dunlingr releases a shockwave covering the frontal area (3-tile wide and 3-tile long), dealing 4 hits of 40% + 5% ATK damage each to enemies within. If the Bell of Order is set to <sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_1">Spellbind, Dunlingr reduces the enemies' ATK SPD by an extra 60 for 4s. If the Bell of Order is set to <sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_2">Curelock, Dunlingr deals extra damage equal to 3% of the enemies' lost HP, up to 30% of his own ATK.
每当满足指定的秩序所需的条件时，获得护盾。
Dunlingr gains a shield whenever conditions of the specified order are met.
若秩序钟形态为“<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_1">禁咒”，每当敌人释放终极技能时，顿里尔获得可以抵御130% + 20% ATK伤害的护盾，持续到战斗结束；若秩序钟形态为“<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_2">抑生”，每当自身累计损失20%最大生命值时，获得可以抵御130% + 20% ATK伤害的护盾，持续到战斗结束。

If the Bell of Order is set to <sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_1">Spellbind, Dunlingr gains a shield that absorbs 130% + 20% ATK damage whenever an enemy casts their Ultimate, lasting until the battle ends.
If the Bell of Order is set to <sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_2">Curelock, Dunlingr gains a shield that absorbs 130% + 20% ATK damage each time he loses 20% of his max HP, lasting until the battle ends.
护盾抵御的伤害提升至140% + 20% ATK。
护盾抵御的伤害提升至150% + 20% ATK。
护盾抵御的伤害提升至160% + 20% ATK。
战斗中，自身的受到的伤害降低10%，秩序生效期间，自身受到的伤害额外降低5%。
Dunlingr reduces damage taken by 10% during the battle. While the order is in effect, he further reduces damage taken by an extra 5%.
战斗中，自身的受到的伤害降低12%，秩序生效期间，自身受到的伤害额外降低6%。
Dunlingr reduces damage taken by 12% during the battle. While the order is in effect, he further reduces damage taken by an extra 6%.
战斗中，自身的受到的伤害降低16%，秩序生效期间，自身受到的伤害额外降低8%。
Dunlingr reduces damage taken by 16% during the battle. While the order is in effect, he further reduces damage taken by an extra 8%.
使得最远的一名友军不受到秩序的约束。
Dunlingr ensures the farthest ally is not affected by his order.
顿里尔庇佑备战时离自身距离最远的非召唤物友军，使其不受到自身秩序的约束，直至其被击败。
Dunlingr protects the farthest non-summoned ally, ensuring they are not affected by his order until the ally is defeated.
庇佑的角色攻击力提高2%。
Increases the protected ally's ATK by 2%.
庇佑的角色攻击力提高4%。
Increases the protected ally's ATK by 4%.
庇佑的角色急速提高20点。
Increases the protected ally's Haste by 20.
主动释放终极技能时，为友军提升攻击速度或生命汲取。
Dunlingr increases ATK SPD or Life Drain for allies upon casting Echo of Silence.
主动使用终极技能时，若宣告“<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_1">禁咒”秩序，还会使所有友军获得50点攻击速度，持续6秒；若宣告“<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_2">抑生”秩序，还会使所有友军获得25点生命汲取，持续6秒。

Upon casting Echo of Silence, Dunlingr grants all allies 50 ATK SPD for 6s if the order is set to <sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_1">Spellbind, or provides them with 25 Life Drain for 6s if the order is set to <sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_2">Curelock.

每当秩序结束或被刷新时长时，若自身依然存活，则根据秩序钟形态触发额外效果：
“<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_1">禁咒”：所有敌人失去150点能量，并降低10点急速，持续8秒。
“<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_2">抑生”：所有敌人失去150% ATK生命值，并降低50点受愈，持续8秒。

If Dunlingr is alive, each time the order effect of his Bell ends or its duration is refreshed, an extra effect will be triggered based on the Bell's active order:
<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_1">Spellbind: Reduces all enemies' Energy by 150 and their Haste by 10 for 8s.
<sprite name="spui_oldgod_icon_2">Curelock: Reduces all enemies' HP by 150% ATK and their Vitality by 50 for 8s.
